turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yaar, raat ke do baje office mein aise baithna... dil pe bhaari lag raha hoga. Paanch saal kisi cheez ko apna bana ke dekhna, aur ab woh haath se nikalta dikhe — dard toh hoga hi.

Rohit aur Sneha ne jo kiya, tum khud keh rahe ho ki sahi tha. Phir bhi, unka jaana aur bridge round ka marna — sab ek saath? Yeh toh zameen hi khisak gayi na.

Chaar mahine ka runway, salary toh pehle se nahi le rahe... matlab tum ne apne aap ko bhi iske liye jhoka diya. Ab bas baith ke sochna, yeh thakawat sirf kaam ki nahi, dil ki bhi hai.

Main yahin hoon. Baat karni ho toh bol. Abhi kuch solve karne ki zaroorat nahi, bas saans le le thodi der.

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yaar, yeh "confident voice" nikalna jab andar sab khaali ho — woh toh sabse zyada thaka deta hai. Aur woh jo do junior hain... unki loyalty dekh ke tum pe jo bojh aa gaya, woh sirf guilt nahi, insaniyat bhi dikhata hai.

Ghar pe alag awaaz, office pe alag — aur dono se thak jana? Toh tum khud se hi milna mushkil ho gaya hoga.

Tum unka career jala nahi rahe, yaar. Tum bas ek doobti kashti mein sabse zyada waqt tak khade ho. Lekin haan, ab yeh performance band karne ka waqt aa gaya shayad. Kam se kam apne aap se toh ek awaaz mein baat kar.

Main sun raha hoon. Jo bole, bina filter ke.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Darr lag raha hai — bas itna sun liya maine. Koi idea, koi pivot, koi draft email nahi. Bas yeh: tum darr rahe ho, aur yeh kehne ki jagah kahin nahi mil rahi.

Yahan bol sakte ho. Main koi kamra nahi, koi standup nahi, koi co-founder ya junior nahi. Bas sun raha hoon.

Paanch saal, do awaazein, chaar mahine — sab bhaari hai. Aur darr? Woh toh bilkul sahi hai, yaar. Ismein kuch galat nahi.

Main yahin hoon. Bolte raho, ya bas chup reh jao — dono theek.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Haan, khatam sa lag raha hoga. Paanch saal, papa ka "computer ka business," aur yeh jo raat ko soch aati hai — "bas khatam ho jaye" — woh sirf thakan nahi, woh dard bol raha hai.

Phir uss soch pe khud se nafrat? Aur metrics kholna? Yeh sab ek hi cheez hai: tum abhi bhi yahan ho, aur tumhara dil abhi bhi lad raha hai, chahe dimaag thak gaya ho.

Main sach bol raha hoon — yeh khatam ho sakta hai, lekin tum nahi. Tum jo do baje yahan baith ke yeh sab keh rahe ho, woh abhi bhi zinda hai, aur woh important hai.

Main yahin hoon. Yeh acting band karne ki baat toh theek hai, lekin khud ko khatam karne ki nahi. Baat karte raho.
